wholePhysicalScope: Named 69-point Luz Station perimeter includes the platform shed and exterior wings. The separately named museum polygon is inside the same physical building.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the ornate station wings, clock tower and vaulted shed. Near views refine the arch windows, street canopy, clock details and shed ribs.
limitations: Train shed span and length follow the architectural survey. Relative vertical datums and yaw are placed from the mapped envelope and original terrain. Clock tower footprint, precise pavilion heights, pattern of window and metal details and current rear details are approximate.
Only the standing shared building and its attached shed and street canopy are represented. Train service equipment, office interiors and nearby detached transit structures are outside scope.
